# EdgeMenusConfig

> **File:** `config/EdgeMenusConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

EdgeMenus: menus that pop out of a screen edge, holding overlay modules. While the edge menu editor has unsaved edits, the running menus show those (ConfigManager.previews). Named with a Config suffix so the shell entry can be `EdgeMenus`.

### Properties

- `menus` (readonly var)
- `enabledMenus` (readonly var)
- `fieldGroups` (readonly var): A menu's own fields in groups (`x-group`), for the edge menu editor

### Functions

- `isSubmenu(menu)`: A menu with no edge of its own: it opens only beside another, from a Submenu module there (content/parts/MenuSubmenu)
- `menuById(id)`
- `popoutMenuOf(properties)`: The menu a bar widget opens as its popout (its `popoutMenu`, with `showPopout` on), else "": it opens its own popout, if any.
- `menuOpenedBy(widget)`: The id of the menu a bar widget entry opens, as configured (a Button toggling one, or a menu popout; gone or disabled alike), else ""
- `opensOwnPopout(properties)`: A bar widget with a popout of its own opens it: on, and no menu opened in its place
- `menuWithModule(type)`: The first enabled menu holding a module of `type`, else null
- `screenFor(menu)`: The menu's named screen, else the primary monitor
- `edgeOf(menu)`: The menu's edge as a Bar.Location
- `colorsOf(menu)`: The menu's box colours
- `paddingOf(menu)`: Space between the menu's box and its modules: its own, else (-1) the popouts'
- `lengthOf(menu, vertical, unit)`: The menu's length along its edge, from config alone (for the hover strip before the menu has ever been loaded): its modules' grid at card size `unit` (EdgeMenuManager.cardUnitOf), as EdgeMenuBody lay…
- `gridLengthOf(menu, vertical, unit)`: The menu's modules' grid along its edge, unstretched, at card size `unit`
